questions.stem: Who owns the control flow in an AI agent?
options: The model
The program
Both the model and the program
Neither the model nor the program

questions.stem: What is an agent according to the text?
options: A model using tools in a loop
A model using tools in a sequence
A model using tools in a tree
A model using tools in a graph
questions.source_quote: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.

questions.stem: According to the text, what is the relationship between the tool loop and the feedback loop?
options: The tool loop does the work. The feedback loop checks it.
The feedback loop does the work. The tool loop checks it.
Both loops do the work and check it.
Neither loop does the work or checks it.
questions.source_quote: The tool loop does the work. The feedback loop checks it.

questions.stem: What is the harness in an agent?
options: Everything that is not the model
Everything that is not the harness
Everything that is not the check
Everything that is not the trace
questions.source_quote: The harness is everything that is not the model.

questions.stem: According to the text, what is the difference between a loop and a graph in organizing the work?
options: Loop: one agent inside one feedback loop
Graph: the work is split into steps that your code wires together
Both loop and graph are the same
Neither loop nor graph is correct
questions.source_quote: Graph: the work is split into steps that your code wires together.
